main_01.title: The Cracked Bell
main_01.summary: Twelve years after the Long Bell cracked, the valley is singing for itself — badly. A new Listener has come down the road, and the quarry has opened a door that should have stayed shut.

stages.text: Come down the road. Wren is waiting at the ninth switchback.
Walk with Wren to the Listening House.
Ask Pell what the Quarry Door is.
Meet Nissa at the ferry dock.
Cross to Reedwater and see what the Returning have done to the channel.
The valley is listening. So are you.

main_02.title: The Sunken Choir
main_02.summary: The north channel is choked, and the Choir Chime that keeps it clear has gone silent. Nissa needs a resonance fork and a way into the drowned shrine beneath the reeds.

stages.text: Speak with Sable in the tower yard about the Choir Chime.
Craft a resonance fork at Brannoc's bench (3 copper, 2 resin, 1 humstone).
Clear the choke in the north channel with the fork.
Read the survey stone and open the Chime Gate.
Enter the Sunken Choir.
Lower the sluice: open, shut, open.
Pass the echo gallery (optional) and reach the boss door.
Ring the chimes in the window's order. Face the Hollow Stag.
Take the Choir Chime and decide where it belongs.
The channel runs clear. The valley has noticed.

side_pip.title: Pip's Bell
side_pip.summary: Brannoc's kettle-bird has stolen a small copper bell and gone to ground in the old dovecote. Pip is not sorry.

stages.text: Find Pip in the kettle-bird roost on the east terrace.
Coax the bell away from Pip. (She will accept a hum-reed.)
Return the bell to Brannoc.
Pip has decided you are furniture. This is an honour.

side_ferry.title: The Ferryman's Debt
side_ferry.summary: The north dock is held together with rope and habit. Nissa owes the Reedfolk a working landing before the winter crossing.

stages.text: Gather 4 hum-reed and 2 resin for the dock repair.
Repair the north dock.
Tell Nissa the dock will hold.
The winter crossing is safe. The Reedfolk remember.
